name: Kinanaki no Mori
source:
The protagonist decides to work as a "maid" at the Demon Kings mansion but...
The Demon King's violent behavior makes every day a hardship. Even so, she works hard.
But then one man will announce these words.
"Get out of Kinanaki Forest!"

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
主人公决定在魔王的宅邸担任“女仆”，但是……
魔王的暴力行为让每一天都很艰难。即便如此，她仍然努力工作。
但随后一个男人说出了这些话。
“滚出木无木之森！”

[翻译自官网]
